red_counterproof.method: Original file-only selector injected into loaded generator in an isolated pytest process; product source was not reverted.

coverage: Files inside explicitly cited directories, including nested PNG/PPTX/JSON and hidden manifest files.
Existing direct-file and opencode hashes are unchanged when their bytes are unchanged.
Inventory counts are unaffected by cited asset expansion.
Source keys are sorted and repeated collection is identical.
File/directory links escaping the workspace are not read; directory-link cycles are not traversed.
provenance_limits: The initial RED selection did not produce a usable failure log; a later attempt reported missing test node IDs. Neither is counted as behavioral RED.
The valid RED is the isolated original-selector counterproof recorded separately above.
The earlier historical inventory run had 11 passes before the restored asset tests were present; final acceptance uses the 13-case run.
Only temporary fixture inventories were collected; primary compilation and real inventory regeneration remain with the root agent.
Nested symbolic directories are skipped even when their targets are inside the workspace.
Asset hashes inventory bytes and do not establish scientific validity or external execution.
